definition: to force something open with a crowbar
description: A flooded narrow street of old tall houses. A young woman with curly hair in a yellow raincoat, a sparkly silver dress and black boots stands in knee-deep water and forces a long iron crowbar into the gap of a blue wooden bakery door. The door bursts open with a splash and splinters, and she lowers the crowbar and laughs. A ginger cat sits on the brass door knocker above her, a loaf and a croissant float in the water, the shop window is full of bread, and two men carry a ladder behind.

de.answer: Sie hebelt die Tür mit einem Brecheisen auf.
de.question: Was macht die Frau gerade?
